summary: Prudential plc furnished a 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 standard major-holdings notification. Norges Bank disclosed that on 15-Sep-2026 its total voting rights in the issuer crossed above 5%, reaching 5.042598%, comprising 5.021845% direct shares (125,010,019 votes) plus 0.020753% via lent/transferred stock (516,601 votes), up from a prior 4.039570%. The issuer was notified 16-Sep-2026. No board recommendation, advisor, price, or transaction mechanics appear; this is a passive disclosure of aggregate ownership, not a tender, buyback, or special situation. Watch for further TR-1 updates if the stake changes.
